fields.why: Claims rest on call counts per half-year with no denominator (1984 calls; Table 1 counts by period), which the brief classes as count/rate; B kept only the percentages.

brief_issues: Whether a report's total case or call count (the frame for its percentages) is a count/rate outcome is decided inconsistently; the 'event counts per period with no denominator' rule could say explicitly that it applies to case totals in surveillance and case-series reports.
